name: Batteries Included Teen Council
org: City of Las Vegas, with Clark County School District and Nevada Partners
what_you_do: Join a teen council at a high school or community center. You do after-school activities. They cover leadership, community service, career plans and college prep.
who_can_apply: Teens in Las Vegas. The program page does not give an age or grade range. The registration form asks for your grade, school and a parent signature.
pay_detail: Free. The city's registration form says activities are free of charge. It does not pay teens.
duration: Year-round. Meeting days and times depend on the site.
deadline_text: No deadline stated. The registration form says the councils are always looking for new members.
how_to_apply: Fill out the online registration form on the program page. Ask your nearest teen council site for meeting dates and times. Questions: call the city at (702) 229-6113, the contact named on the program page.
notes: The registration form lists councils at several high schools and community centers. Check with the city for the current site list. A parent signs the form. The form says each council has an adult advisor.
